name: ic3
description: IC3: browser extension that shows free seat counts on the ebilet.intercity.pl connection list.

scripts.lint: bun run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run lint
scripts.start:firefox: bun run build firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --target firefox-desktop --start-url https://ebilet.intercity.pl/
scripts.start:chrome: bun run build chrome && web-ext run --source-dir dist/chrome --target chromium --start-url https://ebilet.intercity.pl/
